chunks: And from him, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I saw Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام praying in his sandals more than once, and I never saw him take them off at all.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat while wearing sandals?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the observed practice of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام praying while wearing his sandals. It indicates the permissibility of performing salat in footwear when there is no impediment to the prayer.
